title: MagicStart
tagline: VR game web3 Steam and VR film web3 Disney(we make lots of VR film ourselves)
description:
As a developer and a VR film director who just won Tokyo Film Award , I use walletconnect, Polygon and Klaytn to build a web3 VR game Steam(create to earn) and VR film web3 Disney(we make lots of VR film ourselves), empowering every 3d modeling designers.
WE ENABLE every VR game player could receive NFTs through motions in VR world. And creators will get awarded by that too.
how_its_made:
We use WalletConnect to sign in our VR game and all VR films we made (and all nfts inside it)'s been made on Polygon and Klaytn successfully, with smart contracts done.We will build a platform both on Polygon and Klaytn, expanding VR creators community.
